replaces: The flat-badge branded slides-v2 files published under decision 0012 on 2026-09-15 (and a container-cube draft staged later that day, whose open-receptacle cubes the owner rejected before it was ever published); these files are new generations, not edits of either; four of them (glass-profile-stack-light.png, address-ribbons-dark.png, identity-orbits-dark.png, identity-network-light.png) were then replaced by precise-object edits of their own generation output, the first two through a chain of two edits, recorded in their edit blocks

generation.mode: generation from references: each file is a new image generated from its prompt with two or three of the repository's already-public onboarding illustrations supplied as style and composition references; no earlier published background and no private design-file export was an input. Four entries additionally carry an edit block: after the final review of 2026-09-16, the generation output of glass-profile-stack-light.png and address-ribbons-dark.png was replaced by a precise-object edit of that same output by the same generator (the sneaker only, to remove a swoosh-like side stripe), and at the final visual cleanup later the same day those two edited outputs and the generation output of identity-orbits-dark.png and identity-network-light.png were replaced by further precise-object edits (the sneakers and a blank cube replaced by brand-neutral objects, the cube tops re-rendered as smooth convex planes, a sculpture behind a cube removed); each edit block records the final edit's generation id, kind, the superseded output it targeted by hash and generation id, the verbatim edit prompt and, for the two chains, the earlier edit as superseded lineage; the entry's prompt remains the generation prompt that produced the scene and the cubes
generation.referenceNote: The three files are the shipped onboarding collages republished under decision 0011 (assets/slides/onboarding/PROVENANCE.json, byte-identical to the mobile bundle). They were supplied to the generator as references for the layered composition language and the soft-object family, were not edited and were not copied into any output; each entry lists the references its generation received
generation.supersededReferences: node 1131:25142 (Box 5a, the front-facing rounded badge render behind the flat-badge set of decision 0012) and the create-profile raw image node 1737:1014 in frame 1737:1009 (the open-receptacle illustration behind the rejected, never published draft of 2026-09-15) are superseded for generation geometry by decision 0013 and are not inputs to any of these prompts
generation.geometry: every prompt asks for solid, sealed, closed UP! cubes: monolithic rounded dice with smooth, continuous, unbroken top and side planes, the exact white UP! once on the front face and no other readable text, and rejects in its Avoid line every hole, opening, slot, lid, rim, cavity or receptacle, every document, card or object entering or emerging from a cube, and handles, tabs or protrusions on the top. The Universal Profile is a container; the cube that stands for it is closed, and the layered ecosystem around it shows what it holds
generation.edits: every edit prompt is a precise-object edit that states the closed geometry and the closed or sealed cube tops as invariants, names the UP! cubes and preserves the exact UP! lettering, edits only the named region, adds no new text, forbids a watermark and rejects in its Avoid line any opening and any insert on or from a cube; the two object-replacement prompts (the sneakers, and the blank cube of the dark address-ribbons file, replaced by brand-neutral rounded objects without text, logo or branding) also reject footwear, swooshes, stripes, logos, emblems, words, letters and monograms, the top-plane-cleanup prompt (identity-orbits-dark.png) edits only the top planes into smooth continuous convex surfaces that read as sealed solid dice and rejects insets, recesses, seams and receptacles, and the occlusion-removal prompt (identity-network-light.png) removes only the named sculpture, requires visible background around the cube top and rejects cones, bells and objects touching or behind it; the two superseded first edits of the chains (the sneaker's stripe only) are kept as lineage. The validator checks them with the edit-prompt contract and its kinds in scripts/validate/branded-backgrounds.json (a keyword and pattern gate, not a proof of the pixels)
generation.authorization: product owner, 2026-09-16; recorded in decisions/0013-container-cube-slide-backgrounds.md (the correction of decision 0012 and of the rejected open-receptacle draft)

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium 16:9 presentation background, light register, opaque edge-to-edge
Primary request: Create a sophisticated Universal Profiles identity collage inspired by the supplied layered brand artwork.
Subject: One large SOLID SEALED dice-like rounded periwinkle cube on the right third, plus three smaller sealed UP! cubes. Each cube is a monolithic solid with smooth continuous surfaces: front carries exact white "UP!", side and top are uninterrupted glossy periwinkle with NO features.
